title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
focus: Explain the Adam update for a single parameter over a short sequence of gradients. Let the learner edit the gradients, beta1, beta2, the step size alpha and epsilon. Show the first and second moment estimates, their bias-corrected versions and the update at each step. Check that at step 1 the bias-corrected first moment equals the gradient, that the bias-corrected second moment equals the squared gradient, and that the size of each update is at most about alpha when epsilon is small.
